facts.fact: The director of the health ministry's CCDOSS unit said two hospitals, one health centre and one health post use the digital patient record, with over 127,000 patients registered.
The CCDOSS director said one health centre and one health post use the digital patient record, with a target of 20% of health centres using it.
The digital patient record is one of six flagship projects presented by the health ministry's CCDOSS unit, which says the programme became a State project with several partners.

SEN.note: Interoperability is an ambition of the roadmap; no exchange in service or being built is stated.
No national health reporting system is described.
A validation workshop is described but it does not say people outside government took part.
